scope: Single request, single token decode. No batching or prefill change.
status: W2-eight local-gather candidate rejected for production after repeated model regression in performance; numerics passed
device: RyzenAI-npu6 / XDNA2 AIE2P, eight columns, default power mode; XRT 2.25.00 firmware 1.0.0.63
precision: BF16 weights and GEMV operands, unchanged FP32 sums/residual/norm and WKV state; output-row partition does not change per-row reduction order

topology.candidate: 4 W1 + 8 W2 + norm/mix + 2 local residual + parameter copy + 2 residual copies = 19 compute workers
topology.weight_supply: Twelve independent contiguous weight stripes, no weight repack or interleaved runtime descriptors
topology.gather: Two five-input groups, then two-way final join; host DMA scatter preserves original projection/residual ABI
topology.parameter_supply: One 6144-float parameter transfer, split to coefficients and copy4096; three input streams plus residual and twelve weights use all sixteen shim MM2S channels

benchmark.workload: fixed synthetic token IDs, sequential prefill, no sampling

validation.stage: Independent FP64 oracle, shift/replay, immutable inputs and BO guards passed; max_abs=2.42144e-07

stage_initial_us.scope: Same-program repeated dispatch, cannot stand in for alternating production execution. Conservatively preliminary; use model comparison for decision.

limitations: Whole-model slowdown is established for this topology; it does not prove a universal 4-worker optimum or DDR saturation.
Compute, FIFO and DMA attribution still being investigated; no all-tile utilization claim.
Current BF16 and INT8-FFN production already fuse seven recurrent lanes plus eight output projection workers into a 31-core graph. INT8-FFN-output uses a different recurrence/output route.
decision: Keep default production artifacts untouched. Preserve isolated experiments and measurements; do not promote this 8-W2 topology.

four_worker_control.workload: Same 8 prefill / 48 decode / 2 trials / 4 warmup as main comparison
four_worker_control.interpretation: New parameter/local-gather topology itself costs end-to-end time. Across these tested variants production 4+4 remains best; not a universal parallelism limit.

unsupported_followups: All twelve matrix-core trace: col0 has no free S2MM; egress7 fails routing. Pair traces with egress2/3 and single last-W2 trace egress3 also fail routing. No candidate device stall percentages inferred.

Residual forwarded by norm to two gathers exceeds producer DMA output budget (3 > 2), even with norm/mix pinned adjacent because norm_pair also has diagnostic consumer. Single residual stream split to separate residual inputs avoids that explicit problem but hits compute-peer placement, then an input S2MM capacity error with added activation memory fanout. Not dispatched; abandoned code stays out of retained compiler.

reproduce.model_root: Symlink unchanged production subdirectories into the candidate root; never replace or compile through production symlinks. Set VALUE_CORES=4 for control.
